items.question: Find the checking balance of the accounts whose savings balance is higher than the average savings balance.

items.question: Show the distinct director of films with market estimation in the year of 1995.
items.query: SELECT DISTINCT T1.Director FROM film AS T1 JOIN film_market_estimation AS T2 ON T1.Film_ID  =  T2.Film_ID WHERE T2.Year  =  1995

items.question: Give the name of the student with the most likes.
items.query: SELECT T2.name FROM Likes AS T1 JOIN Highschooler AS T2 ON T1.student_id  =  T2.id GROUP BY T1.student_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What are the names of the people who are older 40 but no friends under age 30?
items.query: SELECT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 JOIN PersonFriend AS T2 ON T1.name  =  T2.name WHERE T2.friend IN (SELECT name FROM Person WHERE age  >  40) EXCEPT SELECT T1.name FROM Person AS T1 JOIN PersonFriend AS T2 ON T1.name  =  T2.name WHERE T2.friend IN (SELECT name FROM Person WHERE age  <  30)

items.question: Find the name of the source user with the highest average trust score.
items.query: SELECT T1.name FROM useracct AS T1 JOIN trust AS T2 ON T1.u_id  =  T2.source_u_id GROUP BY T2.source_u_id ORDER BY avg(trust) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: What is the average duration of songs that have mp3 format and resolution below 800?
items.query: SELECT avg(T1.duration) FROM files AS T1 JOIN song AS T2 ON T1.f_id  =  T2.f_id WHERE T1.formats  =  "mp3" AND T2.resolution   <  800

items.question: What are the names of customers who have a loan of more than 3000 in amount?
items.query: SELECT T1.cust_name FROM customer AS T1 JOIN loan AS T2 ON T1.cust_id  =  T2.cust_id WHERE amount  >  3000

items.question: What are the names of parties that have both delegates on "Appropriations" committee and
items.query: SELECT T2.Party FROM election AS T1 JOIN party AS T2 ON T1.Party  =  T2.Party_ID WHERE T1.Committee  =  "Appropriations" INTERSECT SELECT T2.Party FROM election AS T1 JOIN party AS T2 ON T1.Party  =  T2.Party_ID WHERE T1.Committee  =  "Economic Matters"

items.question: How many instruments does the song "Badlands" use?
items.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT instrument) FROM instruments AS T1 JOIN songs AS T2 ON T1.songid  =  T2.songid WHERE title  =  "Badlands"

items.question: Find the number of vocal types used in song "Le Pop"
items.query: SELECT count(*) FROM vocals AS T1 JOIN songs AS T2 ON T1.songid  =  T2.songid WHERE title  =  "Le Pop"

items.question: Find the names of all directors whose movies are rated by Sarah Martinez.
items.query: SELECT DISTINCT T2.director FROM Rating AS T1 JOIN Movie AS T2 ON T1.mID  =  T2.mID JOIN Reviewer AS T3 ON T1.rID  =  T3.rID WHERE T3.name  =  'Sarah Martinez'

items.question: What are the names of all the aircrafts associated with London Gatwick airport?
items.query: SELECT T1.Aircraft FROM aircraft AS T1 JOIN airport_aircraft AS T2 ON T1.Aircraft_ID  =  T2.Aircraft_ID JOIN airport AS T3 ON T2.Airport_ID  =  T3.Airport_ID WHERE T3.Airport_Name  =  "London Gatwick"

items.question: Find the names of stadiums that the most swimmers have been to.
items.query: SELECT t3.name FROM record AS t1 JOIN event AS t2 ON t1.event_id  =  t2.id JOIN stadium AS t3 ON t3.id  =  t2.stadium_id GROUP BY t2.stadium_id ORDER BY count(*) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Find the names of programs that are never broadcasted in the morning.
items.query: SELECT name FROM program EXCEPT SELECT t1.name FROM program AS t1 JOIN broadcast AS t2 ON t1.program_id  =  t2.program_id WHERE t2.Time_of_day  =  "Morning"

items.question: Find the number of papers published by the institution "University of Pennsylvania".
items.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT t1.title) FROM papers AS t1 JOIN authorship AS t2 ON t1.paperid  =  t2.paperid JOIN inst AS t3 ON t2.instid  =  t3.instid WHERE t3.name  =  "University of Pennsylvania"

items.question: Return the name of the heaviest entrepreneur.
items.query: SELECT T2.Name FROM entrepreneur AS T1 JOIN people AS T2 ON T1.People_ID  =  T2.People_ID ORDER BY T2.Weight DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: Show the names of members that have a rank in round higher than 3.
items.query: SELECT T1.Name FROM member AS T1 JOIN round AS T2 ON T1.Member_ID  =  T2.Member_ID WHERE T2.Rank_in_Round  >  3

items.question: How many exhibitions have a attendance more than 100 or have a ticket price below 10?
items.query: SELECT count(*) FROM exhibition_record AS T1 JOIN exhibition AS T2 ON T1.exhibition_id  =  T2.exhibition_id WHERE T1.attendance  >  100 OR T2.ticket_price  <  10

items.question: Which city is the headquarter of the store named "Blackville" in?
items.query: SELECT t3.headquartered_city FROM store AS t1 JOIN store_district AS t2 ON t1.store_id  =  t2.store_id JOIN district AS t3 ON t2.district_id  =  t3.district_id WHERE t1.store_name  =  "Blackville"

items.question: What is the total balance of savings accounts not belonging to someone with the name Brown?
items.query: SELECT sum(T2.balance) FROM accounts AS T1 JOIN savings AS T2 ON T1.custid  =  T2.custid WHERE T1.name != 'Brown'

items.question: Find the claim that has the largest total settlement amount. Return the effective date of the claim.
items.query: SELECT t1.Effective_Date FROM claims AS t1 JOIN settlements AS t2 ON t1.claim_id  =  t2.claim_id GROUP BY t1.claim_id ORDER BY sum(t2.settlement_amount) DESC LIMIT 1

items.question: When did the web accelerator 'CACHEbox' and browser 'Internet Explorer' become compatible?
items.query: SELECT T1.compatible_since_year FROM accelerator_compatible_browser AS T1 JOIN browser AS T2 ON T1.browser_id  =  T2.id JOIN web_client_accelerator AS T3 ON T1.accelerator_id  =  T3.id WHERE T3.name  =  'CACHEbox' AND T2.name  =  'Internet Explorer'

items.question: How many distinct delegates are from counties with population larger than 50000?
items.query: SELECT count(DISTINCT T2.Delegate) FROM county AS T1 JOIN election AS T2 ON T1.County_id  =  T2.District WHERE T1.Population  >  50000

items.question: Show the authors who have submissions to more than one workshop.
items.query: SELECT T2.Author FROM acceptance AS T1 JOIN submission AS T2 ON T1.Submission_ID  =  T2.Submission_ID GROUP BY T2.Author HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT T1.workshop_id)  >  1
